verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's API introduction explicitly offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec, with a direct link to /api/openapi-public.yaml, for use with your own tooling. The probe's 404s were on different JSON paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, and others), not the documented YAML path, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the documented YAML file resolves and is complete, and any detail on spec versioning or coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: You can [download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec](/api/openapi-public.yaml) to use with your own tooling.
